lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Lucky Seven, the Sunday before the Classic. Slick has a legal pad. He doesn't take notes. He draws one line down the middle.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: Two days. Day one is for staying alive. Day two is for the ones who stayed alive, and they all sit near each other.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: There'll be two hundred and twelve people on Saturday, and about thirty of them know what they're doing. You are going to meet all thirty. Don't be the one who flinches first.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: What do I do if I get scared?

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Be scared. Then fold the right hand. They're two different jobs. People mix them up.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Eat something. Chips don't count calories, but you do.
